jobs.occupation: Mid Level Backend Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description:
💰🇩🇰 up to 48,000 DKK/month gross _(varies by seniority)

_**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you'll own delivery of meaningful pieces of our financial systems and grow your expertise in the domain, helping us scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes ownership of what they build. You'll own medium-sized projects from design through to production, working independently within your team and delivering quality outcomes.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Help rebuild Monta's financial backbone. You'll contribute to the new invoicing system that every customer will use, owning meaningful slices of the new infrastructure.

• Power EU expansion. You'll build features within our compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Deliver core parts of the new invoice system. Build features within the new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows, owning your slice end-to-end and contributing to design discussions.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Build for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll write code with auditability, correctness, and scale in mind, and contribute to design discussions for new components.

• Grow with the team. Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, and help onboard new joiners as you grow into the domain.

What We’re Looking For

• Solid backend engineering experience. You've built and shipped production systems and you write clean, maintainable code. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Some exposure to financial systems is a plus. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness matters — but we'll help you grow the depth.

• A sense of ownership. You take responsibility for what you ship, follow it through to production, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.

• Comfortable asking questions and learning fast. Regulatory and financial domains have a lot of nuance — you bring curiosity and a willingness to dig in.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

**Tools We Use Daily

**

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

jobs.occupation: Data Platform Engineer – Offshore Wind Industry
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building and running reliable, scalable and secure cloud data platforms? Do you want to work in the offshore wind industry, where your engineering skills will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then keep reading: Cadeler is looking for a Data Platform Engineer with your skills and interests!

Cadeler is a global partner in the offshore wind industry, specializing in wind farm construction and maintenance. Our industry is more relevant than ever and plays a critical role in the energy transition, with a strong long-term outlook. As our industry continues to develop, so do we!

We are now looking for a Data Platform Engineer to help build, automate and operate our cloud data platform, ensuring that trusted and well-governed data is available for analytics, reporting and operational decision-making.

**What will you do?

**As our Data Platform Engineer, you will design, build and operate the technical foundations of Cadeler's data platform on Snowflake and Azure. You will work with business teams, application owners, IT and information security to integrate source systems, automate data pipelines and make reliable data available for analytics and reporting.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Design, build and maintain data pipelines from various source systems, using managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran and custom Python where connectors fall short

• Orchestrate and schedule pipelines, handle dependencies, retries and backfills, and manage Snowflake warehouse sizing and compute cost

• Own CI/CD and source control in Azure DevOps: branching strategy, PR reviews, automated deployments and environment promotion (dev, test, prod), with database objects and infrastructure managed as code

• Design and implement dimensional data models (facts, dimensions, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions) across raw, staging, integration and mart layers

• Set up pipeline monitoring, anomaly detection and alerting, and troubleshoot and resolve incidents in production

• Deliver curated, performant datasets and semantic-ready measures so departments can build reports in Power BI

**To Succeed In This Role

**Being part of the Cadeler community means having a natural interest in and care for the environment, and in our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for an innovator with a solution-oriented mind, who thrives in a fast-paced environment with many different interfaces.

We think you will be a good match if you have:

• A university degree in a relevant area such as computing, statistics or mathematics

• 3+ years of hands-on experience as a data engineer or data platform engineer

• Proven experience designing, building and operating production data pipelines

• Advanced SQL skills and strong Python skills for data processing, automation and tooling, and experience with dimensional modelling

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake (warehouses, RBAC, storage and compute management, cost control) and the Azure ecosystem

• An understanding of data security, governance and access control principles, as well as ability to define and write logic that transforms raw data into useful, interpretable, business-driven datasets

• Fluent spoken and written English

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler is headquartered in Copenhagen, with offices in Vejle, Norwich, Rotterdam and Taipei, as well as colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIV).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

**Apply

**Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don't hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible and no later than the 6th of November.

If you have any questions about the position, and/or for practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

****Job Description:

****Driven by a passion for business growth...

• dedicated to customer success...

• guided by an analytical, professional mindset...

• empowered by a collaborative spirit!

If you are motivated by these challenges, we invite you to become a vital member of our global Standard Parts team in Copenhagen. As our market expands significantly, you will have a unique chance to shape our strategic focus and champion the continued growth of Satair’s Standard Parts portfolio!

Our Mission:

Our objective is to grow revenue, profitability and positive cash flow of the standard parts business by building a competitive product portfolio to fulfill the needs of our aerospace customers. We ensure that the market is serviced in an efficient way by building long term relationships with suppliers and customers as well as building the internal business model and processes to achieve this.

**What The Job Is...

**As the Product Manager for Standard Parts, you will serve as the primary global representative for standard parts, providing strategic direction and guidance to key stakeholders.

Based in Copenhagen, this role forms an integral part of the global product management team overseeing the standard parts product line (encompassing C&E, hardware, fasteners, consumables, and raw materials). Collaborating closely across all relevant functional areas within the Satair Standard Parts network, you will actively drive business operations-leading continuous improvement efforts, gathering market intelligence, implementing business processes, and overseeing fulfillment support.

The Standard Parts Product Line is entering into a phase made of strong ramp up combined with an important challenge on our competitiveness. The Jobholder will have the great opportunity to shape and lead this role in the Customer Service organization.

Primary Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution

• Develop and execute end-to-end commodity product strategies, aligning business goals with evolving market demands and customer needs.

• Define and drive cross-functional solutions and process integrations, serving as the subject matter expert to ensure product readiness and operational excellence.

Operational Efficiency & Performance Management

• Analyze performance data to drive revenue and profitability targets; champion continuous improvement and automation efforts..

• Serve as the primary liaison between customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to resolve critical issues and optimize the end-to-end value chain.

**How Will You Contribute To The Team...

**Desired Skills & Experience:

Business Acumen & Entrepreneurial Mindset

• Strong business acumen with a focus on ownership and value creation.

• Entrepreneurial drive to challenge the status quo and push business initiatives forward.

• Proactive approach to identifying and mitigating business risks.

Analytical & Operational Excellence

• Advanced data analytics and interpretation skills to derive actionable insights.

• Operational rigor through Lean principles and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace (Sheets, Slides) and ERP systems (e.g., SAP).

Product & Industry Knowledge

• Deep understanding of the Commercial Aviation Aftermarket supply chain.

• Dedication to acquiring and maintaining deep technical product/commodity knowledge.

Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration

• Exceptional stakeholder management and negotiation skills.

• Collaborative, 'out-of-silo' mindset with the ability to bridge cross-functional interests.

• High degree of autonomy, self-discipline, and professional English proficiency.

Academic/Professional Background

• University Degree (Engineering, Commercial, or equivalent) or equivalent professional experience.

• Minimum of 5 years’ proven experience within the aviation aftersales industry, preferably in distribution business, MRO, or aftermarket sales/product management

Travel required:

• This role will require regular travel worldwide, and as such you need to be able to travel accordingly

****What does your next challenge look like?

****At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

****What do we offer at SATAIR?

****At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**Our Values

**Our values aren’t just words on a wall. They capture our culture, and the behaviours we see and strive for every day.

• Kindness & caring — We celebrate brilliance that comes without big egos or sharp elbows, and we win while raising each other up.

• Curiosity & innovation — Entrepreneurship is in our blood. We’re inquisitive, challenge convention, think big, and move fast.

• Remarkable quality & service — We take joy from delighting our clients and pride ourselves on ensuring every interaction is exceptional.

**Diversity, equity and inclusion

**Board Intelligence is committed to building a team that reflects the breadth of experience, background and perspective needed to do this work well. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic.

If you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please let us know and we will accommodate them.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Experience Design transforms complex financial workflows into intuitive solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. We bridge sophisticated investment technology with the people who depend on it — portfolio managers, compliance officers, and analysts operating in high-stakes environments where precision and speed matter.

Our Global Experience Design team operates as a centralized center of excellence with distributed impact. We maintain unified standards and processes globally while embedding designers directly within product teams for deep collaboration and contextual expertise. This lets us stay consistent across SimCorp's product ecosystem while scaling expertise efficiently across markets and time zones.

As Principal Experience Designer, you will serve as the senior design authority for our most complex, strategic initiatives, influence design direction across multiple teams, and mentor senior designers.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead design for SimCorp's most complex and strategic initiatives, contributing to the overall strategic vision and design craft excellence.

• Establish design patterns and standards adopted across the organization, and influence design system evolution and adoption.

• Drive innovation in financial technology user experience, influencing multiple products across the organization.

• Partner with senior product leadership on roadmap planning, and represent the design perspective in architectural and technical decisions.

• Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert in UX.

• Work closely with engineering leadership on technical feasibility, and collaborate with user research on strategic research initiatives.

• Partner with customer success to integrate user feedback, and present design vision to executive stakeholders.

• Work independently and cross-functionally with senior leadership.

• Mentor Lead and Senior Experience Designers, and contribute to hiring decisions for senior design roles.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to — and interested in — learn the rest.

• 8+ years of design experience, with deep expertise in enterprise software.

• Proven track record leading complex, multi-team design initiatives.

• Strong systems thinking and design pattern recognition.

• Ability to navigate between high-level strategy and detailed execution.

• Skill in translating complex financial concepts into clear, actionable interfaces.

• Experience getting the most from AI tools in crafting creative solutions.

• Experience mentoring senior designers and design leaders.

• Ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and drive stakeholder consensus.

• Self-directed and results-oriented, taking ownership of projects while contributing to our collective design practice.

• Experience with the fintech domain is a plus.

**Benefits

**Attractive salary and bonus scheme are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model - working from SimCorp's office two days a week. And opportunities for professional development: there is never only one route - we offer a personal approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp.

Professor within Microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems
 Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  
 The Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences (PLEN); Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as full Professor within the area of microbial interactions in plant and environmental systems.

  Research and teaching at PLEN covers topics within Agriculture, Plant Science, Biotechnology, Biosolutions and Environmental Sciences, dealing with a wide range of subjects focusing especially on plants, soil, and microorganisms from molecules through organisms to populations and anthropogenic ecosystems. It is our vision to maintain and develop our position as one of the leading departments for plant science and the related areas based on excellent basic and applied research.

  The department hosts state-of-the art infrastructure and unique field research facilities, with many opportunities for collaborations across the department. The department is organised into four sections, and the appointed professor will be affiliated to the section of Environmental Sciences located at the Frederiksberg campus.

  The section of Environmental Sciences carries out world-leading research across diverse disciplines, including soil microbiology, chemistry, agrohydrology, ecotoxicology, to assess and mitigate human impacts on ecosystems. By combining measurements, experiments, and modelling, the section supports both basic environmental science and applied solutions for sustainable agriculture, climate mitigation, and clean soil and water. The section of Environmental Sciences conducts world-leading research covering environmental biology, chemistry, and ecosystem science. Focusing on agroecosystems and impacts on soil, water, and the atmosphere, the section connects fundamental discoveries to solutions for targeting climate impacts, microbial diversity, and toxicological challenges.

  The professor is expected to teach both at the BSc and MSc levels primarily in the Biotechnology and the Natural resources and Environmental Sciences programmes at the Frederiksberg Campus and to expand these regular teaching commitments to the new MSc in Biosolutions in Kalundborg.

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Description of qualifications needed

  The professorship is advertised within the area of microbial solutions for climate-friendly and sustainable production systems. Full exploitation of these solutions requires basic understanding of the complex interactions in the environment which shape microbial communities and their functions in soil and at the plant root interface.

  Hence, the appointed professor should have a broad knowledge of microbial ecology including microbial functioning under soil conditions, drivers for microbiome assembly as well as microbe-microbe and plant-microbe interactions of importance for soil and plant health. It is expected that the professor has a recognized international position in the field and contributes to the design and implementation of new methodologies within microbial ecology. The successful candidate is expected to drive research within:

   	
• Model system development for causality and mechanistic understanding of microbial functioning under natural soil conditions 	
• The microbial component of N and P nutrition in agricultural systems 	
• Drivers for root colonization and microbial assembly in agricultural systems 	
• Microbial functions of importance for soil health and functioning 	
• Microbial solutions for climate mitigation and sustainable plant production   The appointed professor is expected to cover teaching in existing courses both at the MSc and BSc levels in subjects related to microbiology, molecular genetics and biotechnology. Likewise, the appointed professor is expected to be a driver for the development of courses to ensure high-quality teaching in a constantly changing educational landscape. Supervision of BSc and MSc projects is expected on a regular basis. International candidates are expected to be able to contribute actively to teaching in Danish within 3-6 years, including supervision and assessment of students. Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

  The candidate should fulfil the following criteria:

   	
• PhD or similar in molecular biology, microbiology, biochemistry, or a related field 	
• Profound experience in the study of plant microbe-related issues in the context of sustainable agriculture 	
• An excellent publication record that includes corresponding-author, senior author and first author publications of relevance to the position and demonstrate an impact on the scientific field of microbial interactions related to soils, plants and the environment 	
• Proven leadership in an academic research environment and ability to guide an independent research group to achieve specific goals 	
• Extensive experience in the development, organization, restructuring, and management of courses at BSc and MSc levels, supported by a comprehensive teaching portfolio that documents pedagogic competences and ongoing skills development. 	
• Extensive experience with supervision of BSc, MSc, and PhD students, as well as postdocs 	
• A teaching portfolio that documents teaching experience and reflections on teaching skills 	
• Documented ability to obtain independent research grants from private and public foundations. 	
• A strong track record of successful external/international collaborations. 	
• Documented experience in organizational tasks such as departmental committees 	
• Experience with outreach activities and communication of research to the public and stakeholders via, e.g., popular science events, press releases, interviews, conferences etc 	
• Societal impact in terms of participation in appropriate stakeholder networks   Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  General criteria apply to the appointment of professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  Please read more here: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5c_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-professors.pdf
 
 Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

  
 Salary and employment conditions

  The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.   There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Further information on the department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department Morten Petersen (morten.petersen@plen.ku.dk).

  
 Filing of application
 The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers    

  The deadline for applications is 8 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 18 March 2027.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**

Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

**Our Values:
